I read that with an open mind, but damn was it difficult to do when the author may well have been shouting "I have essentially no connection to the last few decades of skate culture, but let me comment on it vaguely anyway!" There wasn't anything substantive in it, just an extended piece of clickbait. She drew a loose connection between skate and tech as being meritocracies with gender issues, but never went anywhere with it beyond the basic conclusion in the article (which she didn't really give much evidence for). Lazy writing for Wired's readership, just pimped out the words 'skateboarding', 'tech', 'women', and 'sexism' to get eyeballs. Lame.
I concur. I have an issue with having to read everything though, and thought the discussion would be interesting.
